en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled among trees and rolling fields. In the foreground are tightly packed gabled houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows; some facades carry commercial signs. A tall, slender church with a spire stands on a gentle hill to the right, dominating the skyline. In the distance, an industrial complex with a high smokestack rises among more trees and open countryside. The overall scene suggests a turn‑of‑the‑century Central European town. One clearly visible sign on a building reads something like "Marien‑Apotheke," indicating a pharmacy.
